models.name: gpt-5.6-sol
models.description: Flagship choice for difficult multi-file engineering, deep reasoning, long-horizon implementation, testing, and demanding review work.

models.name: gpt-5.6-terra
models.description: Balanced choice for everyday development, scoped implementation, first-pass code review, documentation, and general production work.

models.name: gpt-5.6-luna
models.description: Fast choice for well-defined lightweight work such as summaries, code explanations, log analysis, review prechecks, and small routine changes.

models.name: grok-4.6:slow
models.description: This model is a good implementation model for well-structured tasks and is also pretty good at organizing larger tasks for subagents. However, it does not make the best code for more arbitrary tasks.

models.name: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
models.description: This model is good at implementation and has very good behavior. It is not a smart model, so it shouldn't be used for arbitrary tasks, but for well-structured tasks, it is very fast and very efficient. Mainly prioritize GPT models. However, if the user asks, feel free to use this for implementation.

models.name: @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash
models.description: Same as above, use this one first, switch to other if limits are hit
